card.name: Adverse events 'have occurred' in warnings
card.fires_on: The word 'occurred' right after 'have' or 'has' when a warning says a serious reaction was seen with a drug. Also weaker on 'of' after 'Cases' and on 'trials' in risk statements.

modes.label: Occurred after have
modes.description: The verb 'occurred' follows 'have/has' in a statement that a serious event happened with a drug.
modes.example: Severe, life-threatening, and fatal pulmonary adverse reactions consistent with interstitial lung disease (ILD)/pneumonitis have<< occurred>> with ALUNBRIG.

modes.label: Cases of / clinical trials
modes.description: Linking words in report phrases such as 'Cases of' or 'in clinical trials'.
modes.example: 5.8 Risk of Hepatitis, Hepatic Events Cases<< of>> cytolytic hepatitis and hepatitis with ja
